title: OpenCode Permissions: opencode.json
description: Permission rules for OpenCode: default ask, read allowed, git allowed except push/clean/reset-hard, rm/mv/rmdir denied, wrangler deploy/delete always ask.

steps.description: Schema and root: schema URL and permission block start.
Defaults: catch-all ask, read allow, edit ask, external_directory deny, skill allow.
Git rules: git commands allowed except push, clean, and reset --hard which ask.
Test commands: npm test, npx vitest, npm ci all allowed without asking.
Safe commands: ls and cat allowed for inspection.
Denial and ask: rm/mv/rmdir denied, wrangler deploy/delete/d1 delete always ask.
